columns.name: PRFL_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key for the person profile tables. It is used by the source to identify the profile.

columns.name: SOURCE_ID
columns.description: The Id for the social data source.

columns.name: PROFILE_REPO
columns.description: The unique Id for writing to repo.

columns.name: FIRST_NAME
columns.description: This is the first name of the person.

columns.name: MIDDLE_NAME
columns.description: This is the middle name of the person.

columns.name: LAST_NAME
columns.description: This is the last name of the person.

columns.name: ALIAS
columns.description: This is an identifier by which a person is known as.

columns.name: GENDER_CODE
columns.description: A string code for gender: MALE, FEMALE or NA (not available).

columns.name: EMAIL
columns.description: The email address of the person.

columns.name: YEARS_OF_EXP
columns.description: This is the number of years of work experience of the person.

columns.name: INFLUENCE_SCORE
columns.description: This is a value which indicates a person's social influence.

columns.name: IS_SELECTED_FLAG
columns.description: A flag to indicate the selected person: Y for yes; N for no.

columns.name: IS_ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: A flag to indicate whether the profile is active or not. Y for yes; N for no.

columns.name: SOCIAL_COMPLIANCE_CODE
columns.description: The code for social compliance.

columns.name: RESUME_URL
columns.description: The URL to the person's resume.

columns.name: IMAGE_URL
columns.description: The URL to the person's photo image.

columns.name: LIKED_BY
columns.description: This is a list of other persons that have made a positive acknowledgment about this person.

columns.name: ABOUT_ME
columns.description: The profile summary written by the person.

columns.name: ASSOCIATIONS
columns.description: The list of associations for the profile.

columns.name: CURRENT_STATUS
columns.description: The current status of the profile.

columns.name: DNA_CHECKSUM
columns.description: The DNA checksum of the profile.

columns.name: GEEKCODE
columns.description: The geek code information of the profile.

columns.name: HEADLINE
columns.description: The headline information of the profile.

columns.name: HONORS
columns.description: The list of honors for the profile.

columns.name: INDUSTRY
columns.description: The industry information of the profile.

columns.name: INTERESTS
columns.description: The list of interests for the profile.

columns.name: LANGUAGES
columns.description: The list of languages for the profile.

columns.name: MYERS_BRIGG
columns.description: The Myers-Brigg value for the profile.

columns.name: NICKNAME
columns.description: The optional nickname of the person.

columns.name: PERSONAL_URL
columns.description: The personal URL of the profile

columns.name: PLAN
columns.description: The plan information of the profile.

columns.name: SKILLS
columns.description: The list of skills for the profile.

columns.name: SPECIALTIES
columns.description: The list of specialties for the profile.

columns.name: TITLE
columns.description: The title used with the name of the person.

columns.name: PROFILE_TYPE
columns.description: The profile type of the profile.

columns.name: URL
columns.description: The URL for accessing this profile.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: This is the numeric user ID identifying the user.

columns.name: USERNAME
columns.description: This is the login name of the user.

columns.name: USER_GUID
columns.description: This is the GUID identifying the user.

columns.name: USER_DISTINGUISHED_NAME
columns.description: This is the distinguished name of the user.

columns.name: MULTITENANCY_USERNAME
columns.description: This is the multitenancy username of the user.

columns.name: CAREER_STATEMENT
columns.description: This is the career statement of the user.

columns.name: JOB_NAME
columns.description: This is the job name of the user profile.

columns.name: COMPANY_NAME
columns.description: This is the company name of the user profile.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
